title: Madrid declares zarzuela, Spain's traditional musical theatre, a protected cultural treasure
summary: The move supports Spain's bid to have the art form recognised by UNESCO.
body:
The regional government of Madrid has declared zarzuela, Spain's traditional form of musical theatre, a Bien de Interés Cultural, the country's highest level of heritage protection. The decision was announced this month.

Zarzuela, which mixes spoken scenes with songs and dances, began in the 17th century as entertainment at the royal court. Its repertoire runs to more than 10,000 works.

A UNESCO bid

The protection covers zarzuela across the Madrid region, but especially in the capital. Spanish media say it also strengthens Spain's bid to have zarzuela added to UNESCO's list of the world's intangible cultural heritage.

The decision still has to be published in the region's official bulletin.

Sources: Europa Press, Libertad Digital, Madridiario.
author: ICONDAILY
